auditNotes: Sesotho “Di sebetsa hantle” says perform well; it drops the source comparative. Proposed “ho feta” restores better while preserving the direct-sowing condition.
Tshivenda direct-sowing candidate preserves general perform-better meaning through ku antswa; direct-sowing condition is not changed.
Sesotho lightest candidate remains held exact English because bobebe could mean physical lightness/ease rather than least-intensive effective intervention.

For Xitsonga direct selling, lexikulu can describe a large share without explicit more; swo tala in the existing paired slide is a more explicit comparative option. The candidate keeps can and every named tradeoff.
No changes to species, crop list, modal strength, prefixes, or suffixes are proposed beyond the exact word-span repairs above.
